entries.title: Deep technical audit of Module 19
entries.body: Deep technical audit of Module 19 (array architectures); findings corrected and independently re-checked.
items: Module 19: the cost of thinning a 2D array is now stated as about −18 dB two-way (receive SNR ∝ K, −6 dB, plus focal transmit intensity ∝ K², −12 dB, at K = N²/4), corrected in both tables, rule card 8 and answers I4 and I7.
Demo 19.3: elevation slice thickness is now the full −6 dB extent (e.g. 9.6 mm at 60 mm for H = 10 mm, F = 25 mm, previously shown as 4.3 mm); the readout is a wrapping table.

Demo 19.2: the grating-lobe readout now reports the part of the replica lobe that enters visible space (−5.2 dB at −67° for d = 0.53λ, 60°, N = 8) instead of a hard yes/no; the pitch rule gives the finite-aperture margin d ≤ λ(1 − 1/N)/(1 + sin θmax).

Module 19: smaller corrections — element-directivity value (4.9 dB for a λ/2 element at 45°), random-sparse side-lobe statement, SNR-optimal F-number direction, steering-window values (now matching equation 19.10), dB-floor readouts replaced with plain wording, a validity flag for the thin-plate CMUT estimate, and the in vivo rat-brain example now cited to Chavignon et al., IEEE Trans. Biomed. Eng. 2022.

entries.title: Technical audits of fourteen modules; new Explorers tab
entries.body: An external audit of Module 04 and deep technical audits of Modules 08, 17, 22, 23, 25, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33 and 36; all high and medium findings corrected and independently re-checked. New Explorers tab with a first interactive explorer on retrospective transmit beamforming.
items: Module 23 Demo 23.2: the two-way (transmit × receive) pattern is now drawn to −120 dB and emphasised, so it is no longer hidden below the −80 dB floor.

Module 04: bandpass sampling now distinguishes hard spectral support from −6 dB edges (a Gaussian has components of −7 to −8 dB at the zone edges); quarter-cycle samples are interleaved I and Q at different times, not simultaneous pairs; tone (coherent-gain) and noise/PSD (Σw²) normalizations separated, with the −4.26 dB Hann noise case; 0.227 mm labelled as the envelope FWHM of the specified transform-limited Gaussian; Gabor equality stated for the complex envelope (a real RF pulse gives about 0.449); focal-plane phase restored in (04.16); "every linear stage is a Fourier multiplier" restricted to LTI/LSI stages; additive noise kept in (04.9); Doppler alias signed and the velocity defined as its axial component; d = λ/2 is grating-lobe free only for steering strictly inside ±90°; the element factor can favour a grating lobe over a strongly steered beam; delay-rounding floor tied to its random-error model; plane-wave k-space figure redrawn with receive-only support and frequency-dependent shift; several statistics and normalization statements qualified.

Module 04 demos: the window demo keeps tone 2 below Nyquist; the circular-convolution demo requires N ≥ max(L, M); the array demo measures both −6 dB crossings and no longer clips the full-angle plot at −80 dB.

Modules 08, 10, 19, 23: −6 dB widths no longer used as hard band limits (M08); fs = 4f0 samples described as time-skewed I and Q (M08); Kasai Nyquist velocity labelled axial (M08); compressed-pulse width tied to received bandwidth and taper (M10); the grating-lobe pitch bound written as a strict inequality and the element-factor ratio E(θg)/E(θ0) noted as able to exceed 1 (M19, M23).

Module 22: the bone thermal index is now taken only beyond the break-point depth, as IEC 62359:2010 defines it (the focus sweep now reads 1.85 at 20 mm, not 3.62); the FDA measurement-uncertainty rule follows the guidance ratio (40 % uncertainty lowers the comparison level by 7.1 %, not 10 %); the TIB form the demo uses is named; hydrophone intensity error no longer doubled in dB; duty-factor card matches its chart; single-angle plane-wave and ULM presets treated as non-scanning; standards-edition notes updated (secondary sources noted).

Module 23: plane-wave transmit and receive grating lobes are now treated as separate one-way artifacts (the transmit × receive suppression argument applies to focused beams); focusing beyond D²/(4λ) "buys little" (+4 dB at N_F = 1) rather than nothing; the 0.53–0.69 F-number is an SNR break-even, shown next to the Perrot et al. −3 dB rule (F# ≈ 1.4); several demo readouts fixed at slider limits.

Module 08: decimation-aliasing numbers given as echo-dependent ranges; Demo 08.5 now forms IQ through a real mixer, filter and decimator; no-rotation loss range corrected (−15.4 dB at 12.5 mm); Demo 08.6 stops fitting where the shifted spectrum reaches 0 Hz; Parker 1988 summary corrected; the factor 2 after low-pass filtering used consistently.

Module 29: wall-filter cut-offs described as half-power points, not hard removal; Demo 29.7/29.8/29.9 texts and statistics now match their readouts; (29.25) marked as an approximation; IEC 61685:2001 edition cited.

Module 25: Demo 25.1 off-axis target moved off the transmit-beam null (3 mm); speckle and noise coherence values name their estimator; ADMIRE path parametrization described correctly; PSL shown as n/a when no main lobe can be identified.

Modules 30, 31, 32: the short-push displacement FT²/2ρ is now an upper bound outside its short-push condition (the model gives 2.0 µm at 200 µs, not 3.0 µm); companding and strain-filter demo texts match their readouts; the shear-wave timing demo record no longer ends before the wave arrives; the rule of five credited correctly (Baveno VII 10/15/20/25 kPa; WFUMB 2024 adds ≤ 5 kPa); ULM false alarms per frame corrected to about 0.03 for a per-pixel detector; registration residual included in Demo 31.2; FRC thresholds use the three-ring pixel count; sound-speed sweep widened so the F² widening shows, and the layered-phantom text matches the default data.

Module 17: the still-air thermal case now uses the air-loaded element power (B-mode 0.128 W, 2.9 °C; PW Doppler 0.542 W, 12.3 °C); the dematched backing plate claims centre frequency only; the matching worksheet uses the Desilets thresholds; Demo 17.2 sweeps to 2.5 f0; the attenuation downshift gives both the closed form (0.13 MHz) and the numerical centroid (0.19 MHz); the round-trip power-gain convention and the Q definition are stated.

Module 27: multitaper variance figures (per-bin 0.19, pooled 0.17) and attenuation-slope values corrected; Demo 27.7 flags ka above 2 where the Gaussian form factor no longer applies; Demo 27.2 ripple readout relabelled with its estimation noise.

Module 28: Demo 28.4 perfusion fit is bounded and reports non-convergence instead of infinite values, and warns that refill rates above about 2 /s are not resolved at 4 frames/s; the log-compression MTT inflation is presented as example-specific (×1.4 to ×8); Demo 28.2 and 28.3 readouts flag sub-10-cycle bursts, large-amplitude bubble motion and tissue harmonics beyond the plane-wave, lossless, pre-shock range; buckled-shell resonance shown as two branches.

Module 33: Demo 33.1 flags −6 dB widths clipped by the plot window; Demo 33.2 no longer claims an optimum number of lags (inverse-variance least squares only saturates); Demo 33.3 single-screen claims qualified (first-pass error 0.003–0.92 rad over 15 screens); the speckle-limited width is 0.40 mm to 20 ns, 0.48 mm at 30 ns; Demo 33.4 caps the screen depth below the image plane; literature entry 5 retitled to match Demené 2021.

Module 36: the tolerance-factor approximation (36.4) is flagged as not applicable for n < 3 and its sign at g = 0.95 corrected; the MDUFA VI letter is due to Congress by 15 January 2027; the 95 % goal no longer attached to the acceptance review; EU notified-body durations stated as measured from the signed agreement; Demo 36.7 uses Wilson half-widths where the normal approximation is poor; categorical regulatory statements reworded as typical outcomes to confirm with regulatory counsel or FDA.
Module 23 Demo 23.3: x and y axis ranges can be set, with 'zoom to main lobe' and reset.

New Explorers tab (replaces Interview prep in the top bar; Interview prep is under More). First explorer: retrospective transmit beamforming (RTB), physical focused transmits versus the synthetic transmit beam, with K and spacing sweeps; own broadband solver checked against an independent Python solver (NRMSE below 0.04 %) and against Field II 3.24 for one preset (NRMSE 0.34 % or less, widths within 0.05 mm); audited before release.

entries.title: Home page and navigation
entries.body: A redesigned home page and site header; no module content changed except the items below.
items: Home page: the module map and the learning-path selector now sit together at the top, so a path lights up its modules on the same screen.
Site header: logo, compact phone menu (Learn / Reference / About) and a single search; on desktop a "More" menu holds Glossary, About and Review & errata.
Home page wording: "Numbers come from code you can run" replaced by "Formulas are recomputed in code; sources are cited."
"Builds on" lines in Modules 16, 18 and 33 showed a stray "Builds on );" or lost a module link; fixed. Module 33: the symbol W now links to Module 11 and Module 32, Section 32.4.

entries.title: Modules 34–36, more pulsed-wave Doppler, key messages, field lessons, legends and a fuller glossary
entries.body: New Part VI, Systems & practice: Module 34, From echo to photon: the ultrasound display chain (bit depth, compression, gray maps, the DICOM GSDF, monitors, scan conversion, timing, colour, measurements, DICOM storage and display QA; 9 demos, 4 labs). Module 29 gains pulsed-wave sections on high-PRF Doppler, burst and gate design, direction separation, duplex timing, spectrogram estimation, envelope tracing and Doppler indices, volume flow and the simplified Bernoulli relation (3 demos, 2 labs). Both were independently audited before release; corrections are listed below. Modules 28–30 gain a "From signal to clinical number" section (contrast quantification, spectral Doppler measurements and criteria, shear-wave speed to kPa with protocol and cut-offs), and every module now has a compact header with a linked contents list. Module 35, Image enhancement (speckle filters, multiscale contrast, temporal filtering, compounding, 3D denoising and rendering, deep-learning denoisers and their failure modes, evaluation, lessons from other fields). Module 36, From prototype to product (FDA 510(k), Q-Sub, the FDA ultrasound guidance, standards, changing a device after clearance, AI-enabled features in a submission, the path from clearance to launch, recalls to learn from, EU MDR). Module 17 is expanded into a full design-to-production guide (specification to stack, tolerance analysis, fabrication step by step, thermal design, reliability and cleaning, acceptance testing and yield, and the build side of matrix probes and micro-beamforming), with related additions to Modules 16 (material behaviour in use: depoling, self-heating, aging) and 18 (packaging, bias and lifetime of micromachined transducers). Module 25 is reorganized around a method map with consolidated demos. Every module now opens with an "In 60 seconds" box and a "From the field" box of practical lessons, and ends each section with key takeaways; every multi-trace plot has a legend that distinguishes traces by colour and line style (legends shown by default; a switch hides them) and visual-summary panels name their y and x axes; glossary links now appear in every paragraph, card, table and heading, and the glossary has grown from 188 to 466 terms.
items: Module 29: the Hann −6 dB spectral width in the existing text and lab is 78.1 Hz (2·PRF/N<sub>w</sub>), not 79.3 Hz; lab now interpolates the crossing.
Module 29: diameter-error contribution to volume flow stated consistently as +10.25 / −9.75 %; Hatle et al. and Pourcelot references completed.

Module 34 (pre-release audit): GSDF step at 100 cd/m² is 0.75 % (lab fixed); characteristic-curve wording aligned with PS3.14; gCNR under clipping shown as ≈1 with its formula; duplex timing bound corrected; colour-vision-deficiency prevalence sourced (about 8 % of men, 0.4 % of women).

Legend pass (all modules): several demo legends listed curves that were not drawn or missed curves that were, and a few legend swatches were blank; all corrected (e.g. Demo 34.2, 34.5, 24.5, 17.4, 22.4, 22.5, 29.3, 29.8, 25.1).
Module 32: a takeaway range for the layer prior was aligned with the rule card and demo (±0.7–2.5 m/s per layer).
Module 04: the Demo 04.2 note now describes the smooth band shape actually drawn.
Module 28: elastic-shell compression/expansion ratio 1.1–1.3 (was 1.1–1.4); "λ/150" refers to a 2 µm radius.

Module 31: the PALA benchmark (Heiles et al. 2022) combines 11 metrics into its global score (was "18 metrics"); dataset list and figure references corrected; rule card on linking probability clarified.
Module 32: rule figure 5 and its summary card now sit on the exact noise formula (83.5 m/s at 30 mm); small-offset edge delay corrected to 86 ns; Simson Fig. 5 described as rat abdomen.
Module 33: reference details corrected (PNAS 2020 title, Varslot et al. 2004 author order, PRX 2020 Fig. 6 description).
Module 30: an unsupported "digital phantoms" attribution to Palmeri 2021 removed; lab run times updated.

Module 36 reorganized for readability: a roadmap of the path from prototype to launch, a running case (a fictional handheld scanner with an AI liver feature), seven consolidated demos instead of thirteen, and regulatory detail folded into expandable blocks; no regulatory fact was removed, and the rework was re-audited.

All modules: "In 60 seconds" and "From the field" boxes rewritten concept-first (each number with its formula or conditions); "How experts think" cards refined, with why-it-holds and when-it-breaks behind a tap and a few duplicate cards merged.
Module 16: PIN-PMN-PT temperature and coercive-field ranges made consistent (about 100–135 °C, 4.5–7 kV/cm, supplier-dependent) across the table, rule card and text; Module 18 aligned.

Module 20 §20.7 and Module 17: probe surface-temperature limits now stated with their test conditions (43 °C coupled to a tissue-mimicking object, 50 °C in still air; IEC 60601-2-37 2007 edition with amendment) and a note that the 2024 edition revised the clause.

Module 25: cost figures now given as ranges consistent between text and cards; an over-strong MV aberration claim softened; F-DMAS and ADMIRE use claims softened (ADMIRE real-time GPU implementation cited).
Module 17: preamplifier loading for a 1 pF matrix element corrected (6–12 dB on 1–3 pF, not "a few dB"); Curie temperatures now cited.

Independent pre-publication audit (30 Oct 2026): MVDR wording now distinguishes exact distortionless response from cancellation under steering mismatch or coherent interference (M25); complex least squares written with the conjugate transpose (M5); EU MDR classification qualified (Class IIa typical, Rule 10 IIb exceptions, Rule 11 software) (M36); FDA Pre-Sub day-70 stated as a target, subgroup sample size identified as a Wald approximation (M36); FDA ±30 %/±15 % measurement uncertainty attached to the Track 1 table, not Track 3, and not headroom above a limit (M22); probe temperature limits tied to edition and test conditions (M20, M22); λ/4 vs λ/2 capacitance label (M17); ULM detection losses include threshold misses (M31); gCNR invariance and scan-line density stated with their assumptions (M34); provenance of the precomputed ADMIRE benchmark documented (M25); several heuristics qualified (M2, M6, M10, M26, M32, M35).
Site wording: the claim that every number was checked by code, and that every lab runs on each change, replaced by an accurate statement of what is checked and when.

Summary boxes rewritten (all modules): each In 60 seconds line now explains one idea in words first, defines every symbol where it appears and uses only earlier concepts; From the field lessons follow action, mechanism, one check.

Demos and charts (all modules): control labels give name, symbol, unit and a short hint; readouts say what they measure; method cards and tables define their terms; every chart axis has a title with units outside the tick labels; legends can be clicked to show or hide traces; traces use distinct colours as well as line styles; "Symbols used here" notes under demos. Fixed along the way: legend swatches that did not match the drawn colours (M6, M9, M10, M20, M27), M18 effective gap wording (divided by relative permittivity), M26 fourth-moment wording, M24 β/γ wording, a blank metrics panel in M35 Demo 35.3, and module pages now open at the top with vertical scrolling over demos on phones.

entries.title: Corrections from two external reviews; glossary, search, cross-links and licence updates
entries.body: Four external reviews (26–27 Oct 2026) were checked against the source; every confirmed issue is fixed below. Prompted by the second review, 15 modules (06–10, 13, 16–18, 20–22, 25, 30, 32) then had a second equation-by-equation pass for domains, units, index ranges and stated assumptions, with every worked number recomputed; 58 small corrections, summarized below. The second review also ran all 159 MATLAB/Octave scripts in GNU Octave 8.4 (all completed) and 609 numerical checks (604 passed; the 5 failures were the defects fixed here). Glossary extended to 177 terms, plain "Module NN" and "Section NN.x" references are now links, page titles and search metadata improved. Licensing clarified: content stays CC BY 4.0 and the MATLAB scripts and demo code stay MIT; from this version the site design and build tools are all rights reserved (see About).
items: Module 08, after Eq. 08.3: the factor 2 does not "restore the energy of the discarded half"; it makes Re{x<sub>a</sub>} = x, and the analytic signal then carries twice the energy of a zero-mean x. Text corrected.
Module 15, Eq. 15.1: p<sub>0</sub> was used both for the rest pressure and for the acoustic pressure amplitude. The rest pressure is now p<sub>eq</sub>.
Module 25, 25.1 and Demo 25.6: method counts made consistent (twelve methods introduced; eleven compared in Demo 25.6, ten of them computed live in the page and ADMIRE precomputed).
Module 27, Eq. 27.1: autocorrelation written with the complex conjugate, r[l] = E{x[n+l] x*[n]}, consistent with Module 07 (no change for real RF).
Module 01, Eq. 01.12: the period is T = 1/|f| for f ≠ 0 (negative frequencies are allowed; a constant has no period).
Module 02, Demo 02.3: the 1/N scaling option is labelled "two-sided coefficients".

Module 07, Eq. 07.7 and summary table: ρ = cos θ and the range [−1, 1] hold for real variables; complex correlations satisfy |ρ| ≤ 1. Eq. 07.24 is now stated as the narrowband (separated-lobe) approximation.
Module 10, Eq. 10.8: the stationary-phase window argument is (f − f<sub>0</sub>)/B, not (f − f<sub>0</sub>)T/B; S is the analytic-signal spectrum.
Module 11, Eq. 11.7: summation limits corrected for negative lags, n = max(0, −k) … min(N−1, N−1−k).
Module 13, Eq. 13.2: the pseudo-inverse returns A<sup>+</sup>A x (the row-space projection of x), which equals x only for full column rank.
Module 22: Nowicki (2020) DOI corrected to 10.11152/mu-2372 (verified in Crossref).
Module 25, Eq. 25.12: the ridge term μ‖a‖² added to the FXPF objective, so the cost matches its closed-form solution.
Shared eigenvalue routine used by several demos: the stopping test is now relative to the matrix scale (it stopped early for very small matrices).
Build tools read and write UTF-8 explicitly, so the documented build also works on Windows.

Errata: the 57 rechecked flags include one duplicate, so the dispositions sum to 56 distinct claims; wording clarified. The Module 26 open item is narrowed: PICMUS Figs. 2–3, Oelze & Mamou Fig. 3 and gCNR Fig. 1 are now confirmed.

Second pass, Module 06: noise edge written σ<sub>noise</sub>(√(N<sub>x</sub>N<sub>z</sub>) + √n) (σ<sub>n</sub> clashed with the n-th singular value); conditions added for power iteration (c<sub>1</sub> ≠ 0), κ<sub>2</sub> = σ<sub>1</sub>/σ<sub>n</sub> (full column rank) and the Marchenko–Pastur range.
Module 07: Eq. 07.31 units (enter c in mm/µs); E[xy] = E[x]E[y] for uncorrelated variables stated for real variables; mean removal stated in 07.16; lag range of 07.25.
Module 08: the condition for |IQ| = |x<sub>a</sub>| with an ideal low-pass (echo band inside (0, 2f<sub>d</sub>)); u(0) = ½ and sgn(0) = 0 defined.
Module 09: forward–backward filtering gives |H|² only for real taps.

Module 10: the raw-echo centroid shift at 6 cm is −2.6 µs (−2.64), not −2.5 µs; the earlier value came from an FFT wrap-around in the lab script and Demo 10.5, both fixed; Barker/Golay sum limits; FDA Track 3 row now includes the I<sub>SPPA.3</sub> ≤ 190 W/cm² branch.
Module 13: the ill-posedness rule card and cheat sheet now carry the null-space term A<sup>+</sup>Ax; I2 convention note; a cross-reference and the universal-threshold N defined.

Module 16: ε<sup>S</sup> = ε<sup>T</sup>(1 − k<sup>2</sup>) replaced by the correct mode-free permittivity relation (the module's own table gives ε<sup>S</sup>/ε<sup>T</sup> = 0.43, not 1 − k<sub>t</sub><sup>2</sup>); loaded-plate Q renamed to avoid a clash with the material Q<sub>m</sub>.

Modules 17, 18, 20, 21: symbol clashes resolved (lens reflection coefficient vs radius, impedance ratio vs round-trip ratio); Demo 18.1 pull-in hint corrected (halving the vacuum gap cuts V<sub>PI</sub> by about 2.6, not 2.8, because the insulator stays); |sin(πε)| for signed ε in 20.4; voltage-noise and Friis cascades no longer called equivalent; k-space correction uses the unnormalized sinc (21.7).
Module 22: interview I6 push fluence given for both Gaussian (0.09 J/cm²) and rectangular (0.12 J/cm²) 400 µs bursts; the chirp intensity example now states frequency and reference pulse.

Module 25: ADMIRE predictor index renamed (it clashed with the imaginary unit j); FXPF noise fraction kept, not lost, is p/(N−p); power-law exponent and delay-error symbols disambiguated; several index ranges and definitions completed.
Module 30: c<sub>0</sub> in 30.18 defined as in the demo and script (phase velocity at ω<sub>0</sub>); strain-ratio wording; two card values rounded correctly (0.036, 2.43 m/s).
Module 32: ρ in 32.10 is the magnitude of the complex correlation; the 14 m/s Imbault cut-off gap is marked as a working value wherever it is used.

Module 01: Demo 01.1 hint now says the cos trace is unchanged under a direction flip only for φ = 0; the readout shows T = 1/|f|. Module 02: the one-sided amplitude row distinguishes raw and normalized DFT coefficients.

Module 22: new caveat that the calculators are not a substitute for IEC 62359 measurement, IEC 60601-2-37 probe-temperature testing or a conformity assessment, and that a displayed TI excludes transducer self-heating; the two-branch non-scanning TIB and the IEC 60601-2-37:2024 temperature tests (simulated use 43 °C; still air, rise plus offset ≤ 27 °C at 23 ± 3 °C) are described as reported by external reviews and still unconfirmed against the official text.
Module 25: new pitfall with a worked example of MVDR self-nulling under a small steering error (−37.1 dB re DAS, recovered by diagonal loading), reproduced independently by an external review.
New review record at the top of this page, with a per-module table; each module page links to its row ("Reviewed").

entries.title: Glossary added
entries.body: New glossary of 155 abbreviations with short definitions and links to the module that teaches each one. In the modules, the first use of a term in each section is underlined with dots; hover, tap or press Enter on it to see the definition. No changes to module content.

entries.title: First public release
entries.body: 33 modules in five parts, formula sheet, interview collection and MATLAB/Octave scripts. Before release every module was audited claim by claim (about 1,400 claims checked; wrong and imprecise statements fixed and the fixes re-verified). The 57 flags that audit could not confirm (56 distinct claims; one flag was a duplicate) were rechecked against primary sources on 26 October 2026: 32 confirmed, 9 corrected, 12 reworded or removed; the 3 items below are still open.
